config.post.processing.script: { "mappings": [ { "table": "champions_league_games_staging", "script": "MERGE INTO \"champions_league_games\" AS tgt USING (SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t.game_id ORDER BY t.last_updated_at DESC ) AS rn FROM champions_league_games_staging AS t where t.batch_id='${firebolt_param.batch_id}' ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ) as src ON tgt.game_id = src.game_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET score = src.score, last_updated_at = src.last_updated_at WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (\"game_id\",\"host_team\",\"away_team\",\"game_start_time\",\"location\",\"score\",\"last_updated_at\") VALUES (src.game_id, src.host_team, src.away_team, src.game_start_time, src.location, src.score, src.last_updated_at);" } ] }
